description: Clone Merge: copies each of up to eight monophonic inputs a chosen number of times and merges every copy into one polyphonic output

params.text: Sets how many copies are made of each input, from 1 to 16
Sets the channel order at the output: yellow keeps all the copies of one input together, blue lays out the inputs as a set and repeats the whole set

inputs.text: One monophonic signal to be copied; patch these from the top down. Its lamp is yellow while its copies fit within 16 channels and red when they do not, and an input that does not fit is left out

outputs.text: Every copy of every input merged into one polyphonic cable, in the order the GRP button sets

menu: Add Auxilliary Clone expander — places one immediately to the right, giving four more polyphonic input and output pairs copied by the same count
